title: The Table Open Mic @ The Hop Shoppe
event_description: A weekly open mic near the Staten Island Ferry Terminal welcoming singers musicians and poets. Seven to ten minute slots with no cover though a food or drink purchase is suggested.
venue_address: 372 Van Duzer Street, Staten Island, NY 10304
event_venue_information:
The Hop Shoppe

The Hop Shoppe is a gastropub near the Staten Island Ferry Terminal in St. George, serving as a full bar and restaurant with a regular live-entertainment schedule.

The Table Open Mic

Every Sunday, sign-up begins at 7:30 PM for The Table, an open mic welcoming singers, musicians and poets for seven to ten minute sets. Host Donny Teachout keeps the night moving, with DJ Omarolusion running sound. There is no cover charge, though a ten dollar food or drink purchase is suggested, and reserving a seat by calling ahead is recommended.

Other Programming

The Hop Shoppe keeps late hours most nights of the week as a neighborhood gastropub, with the Sunday open mic as its signature recurring performance night.

Good to Know

The Hop Shoppe is located at 372 Van Duzer Street, a short walk from the Staten Island Ferry Terminal.

title: Liberation Open Mic @ Every Thing Goes Book Cafe
event_description: A monthly all media open mic in a beloved Staten Island bookstore cafe. Bring a song a poem an instrument or artwork to share in a five dollar suggested donation community event.
venue_name: Every Thing Goes Book Cafe and Neighborhood Stage
event_venue_information:
Every Thing Goes Book Cafe and Neighborhood Stage

Every Thing Goes is an independent bookstore cafe with a small performance stage that has served as a community gathering place in St. George since 2005.

Liberation Open Mic

Held roughly monthly on a Friday evening from 7:00 PM to 8:30 PM, the Liberation Open Mic welcomes a poem, a song, a guitar or ukulele, artwork or anything else performers want to share. It is an all-media, all-genres night with a five dollar suggested donation and no one turned away for lack of funds.

Other Programming

The cafe also hosts the Staten Island Songwriters' Circle and a rotating calendar of curated musical showcases and poetry nights throughout the year.

Good to Know

Every Thing Goes is located at 208 Bay Street in St. George. Contact the cafe directly to confirm the next scheduled date.

Staten Island Songwriters' Circle

title: Brian's Open Mike @ Curly Wolf Saloon
event_description: A monthly saloon open mic welcoming solo performers and full bands across all musical styles. House bass and drums are available for musicians who want to play without hauling gear.
backline: Bass and drums available on-site for performers
event_venue_information:
Curly Wolf Saloon

Curly Wolf Saloon is a neighborhood bar on Staten Island's south shore that hosts live music and community events alongside its regular bar service.

Brian's Open Mike

On the last Wednesday of the month starting at 8:00 PM, host Brian Smith runs an open mic welcoming solo performers and full bands across all musical styles, plus poetry. House bass and drums are available on-site, making it easy for musicians to sit in without hauling a full backline.

Other Programming

Curly Wolf Saloon hosts additional live-music nights throughout the year as part of its regular bar entertainment.

Good to Know

Curly Wolf Saloon is located at 4116 Hylan Boulevard. Because the schedule is monthly, it is worth calling ahead to confirm the open mic is running as planned.
